To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) cognitive exercises and video games can both improve cognitive abilities in young and old adults; (2) video games can be more fun than cognitive exercises; (3) cognitive exercises can be more motivating than video games; (4) cognitive exercises can improve cognitive abilities in older adults more than video games; and (5) cognitive exercises can reduce the risk of dementia in older adults.

video games and cognitive exercises can enhance a range of cognitive abilities, including attention, memory, and reasoning, and that these effects are mediated by the specific design features of the tools.

(a) video games can enhance cognitive abilities, (b) cognitive exercise programs can enhance cognitive abilities (c) the enhancement effect of video games is larger than that of cognitive exercise programs, and (d) the effect of video games and cognitive exercise programs is larger when the participants are motivated to play or exercise.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how the design of interactive digital media can be used to enhance cognitive abilities.
the potential to use interactive digital media to enhance cognitive abilities.
how the design of interactive media can be optimized to enhance cognition and how the use of interactive media can help us understand the mechanisms underlying cognition.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the field of cognitive training with video games and cognitive exercises is still in its infancy, and the results of the studies reviewed here should be interpreted with caution.
video game play and cognitive training are both associated with cognitive benefits and that the two approaches may have different effects on cognition and brain structure.
we do not yet know enough about how to optimize cognitive enhancement effects from interactive digital media to make definitive claims about which tools are most efficacious.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
video games and cognitive exercises are effective cognitive training tools.
cognitive training via digital media can be an effective means to promote cognitive enhancement.
video games and cognitive training exercises are both capable of enhancing cognitive abilities.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the design of interactive digital media can have a profound influence on the degree of cognitive enhancement observed in users.
cognitive exercises and video games have unique design characteristics that influence the extent to which they enhance cognitive abilities.
the field of cognitive training with interactive digital media is at a crossroads.
